jobs.title: Director, AI Solutions Architect
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Technology Services

Technology Services (TS) is responsible for delivering all enterprise infrastructure, applications and related end user technology services across all Brookfield business groups.

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

Role Summary

Leads the design of enterprise AI solutions that align business priorities, data foundations, architecture standards, and platform capabilities. This role translates complex business needs into scalable, secure, and governed AI solution designs, including GenAI and agent-based use cases. Partners with business, product, data, engineering, security, and governance teams to move high-value AI solutions from concept to production.

Key Responsibilities

Assess business problems and define end-to-end AI solution architectures aligned to enterprise priorities
Translate product and business requirements into scalable, secure, and supportable AI designs
Define architecture patterns for AI, GenAI, retrieval-based, and agent-enabled solutions
Ensure solution designs are grounded in trusted data, integration, and platform architecture standards
Partner with product owners, data architects, engineers, and business stakeholders to shape implementation roadmaps
Guide technology selection, integration patterns, and design decisions across AI solution components
Establish non-functional requirements for security, governance, performance, resiliency, and supportability
Ensure AI solutions align with responsible AI, risk, compliance, and control requirements Review and govern solution designs through architecture checkpoints and design standards
Support pilots, production deployments, and architecture evolution based on business feedback and operational learnings

Required Experience

10+ years of experience in enterprise architecture, solution architecture, data architecture, or AI-related roles
Proven experience designing and delivering complex enterprise technology solutions across multiple systems and stakeholders
Experience with AI, machine learning, GenAI, or advanced analytics solutions in production environments
Experience working with cloud platforms, enterprise data ecosystems, APIs, and integration patterns
Experience operating in regulated, security-conscious, or highly governed enterprise environments
Experience partnering with business leaders to translate strategic priorities into architecture designs

Skills & Qualifications

Technical knowledge and systems expertise: Deep understanding of enterprise architecture, AI and machine learning, GenAI, data platforms, integration patterns, and the data foundations required for scalable AI and agent-based solutions.
Analytical and problem-solving skills: Ability to assess complex business and technical challenges and translate them into scalable, practical, and governed solution designs.
Communication and collaboration capabilities: Strong executive communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional influence skills.
Ability to work in cross-functional or global teams: Experience operating across global teams and aligning business, product, architecture, engineering, security, and governance stakeholders.
Understanding of technology governance, security, or operational practices: Strong understanding of responsible AI, risk management, security, compliance, and operational design requirements for enterprise AI solutions.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience in financial services, asset management, or similarly complex industries
Experience designing AI solutions that support decision-making, workflow automation, or knowledge-based use cases
Familiarity with modern cloud-based data and AI platforms and MLOps or model operations practices
Experience with architecture governance, design review processes, or enterprise architecture frameworks
Exposure to retrieval-augmented generation, knowledge architectures, or agent orchestration patterns

Salary Range: $150,000 - $185,000 CAD

Position Opening Reason:

New Position

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe and respectful; our shared success depends on it. Accordingly, we do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment.

Brookfield is committed to creating an accessible and inclusive organization. We are committed to providing barrier-free and accessible employment practices in compliance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act. Should you require a Human Rights Code-protected accommodation through any stage of the recruitment process, please make them known when contacted and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Director, Finance
jobs.description:
Location

Brookfield Place - 181 Bay Street

Business - Infrastructure

Brookfield Infrastructure Group is one of Brookfield’s primary operating groups. The Infrastructure Group is one of the world’s largest infrastructure investors, owning and operating critical assets across the transport, utilities, energy, and data infrastructure sectors. The Group operates and manages approximately $262 billion of assets owned through its private funds and publicly listed entity, Brookfield Infrastructure Partners. Our portfolio of assets facilitate the movement and storage of energy, water, freight, passengers and data, and are located in North and South America, Europe and the Asia Pacific regions. For more information, visit: https://www.brookfield.com/our-businesses/infrastructure

Brookfield Culture

Brookfield has a unique and dynamic culture. We seek team members who have a long-term focus and whose values align with our Attributes of a Brookfield Leader: Entrepreneurial, Collaborative and Disciplined. Brookfield is committed to the development of our people through challenging work assignments and exposure to diverse businesses.

Job Description

As a member of the Brookfield Infrastructure Finance and Operations team, you will report to the Vice President, Finance and work alongside a strong team and collaborate with several internal and external stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

The responsibilities for this position would include, among other things:

Review quarterly reporting to investors and other users, including financial statements prepared in accordance with US GAAP – Investment Company Accounting and IFRS
Review of investor Partners’ Capital Statements (“PCAPs”) and available commitment schedules on a quarterly basis
Presentation of quarterly results to senior management
Overseeing the team’s interaction with various service providers to ensure information being provided is accurate and provided in a timely basis
Review valuations of fund investments on a quarterly basis
Review of accounting packages for individual legal entities, including review of tax financials
Preparing internal and external audit requests and maintaining appropriate control documentation
Managing and reviewing capital calls from, and distributions to investors
Assist with managing fund operations, including liquidity management, investor queries, forecasting and compliance
Thorough understanding of the legal structure of the various funds and the related impact on funds flows and consolidation
Assist with analysis of complex accounting issues that arise, including the structuring of new acquisitions
Provide oversight on any improvements to the reporting process and actively coach team members
Special projects & ad hoc requests as required

Requirements:

University degree
Professional accounting designation (CPA/CA)
Minimum of seven years of progressive work experience in finance and/or accounting functions;
Experience in private funds and knowledge of the investment management industry, and experience dealing with complex ownership structures would be an asset.
Demonstrated leadership ability and initiative;
Excellent analytical, and problem-solving ability;
Exemplifies the right motivation by aspiring to achieve collective goals;
Ability to work in a dynamic, complex, fast-paced environment, to adapt quickly and to manage changing priorities;
Superior communication skills (oral and written) and interpersonal skills;
Strong organizational skills and ability to multi-task, prioritize and meet deadlines;
Strong financial systems experience, including advanced Excel;
Experience with Mercatus, Workiva, Anaplan all an asset
Self-motivated and pro-active, with respect to both managing workload and professional development.

Salary Range: $160,000 - $175,000 CAD

Position Opening Reason:

New Position

Brookfield is committed to maintaining a Positive Work Environment that is safe, respectful; our shared success depends on it. We do not tolerate workplace discrimination, violence or harassment. We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and make employment decisions based on qualifications, merit, and business needs, without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Applicant information is collected and handled in accordance with our Applicant Privacy Notice. As part of this commitment, we provide barrier-free and accessible employment practices in accordance with the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA) and applicable human rights legislation. If you require a Human Rights Code-protected accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know when contacted, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

jobs.title: Assistant Vice President of Finance, 3002
jobs.description:
Hannover Re Canada is seeking an experienced Assistant Vice President of Finance to join our Accounting and Finance team in our Canadian Branch on a permanent, full-time basis.

The Assistant Vice President of Finance will lead our technical accounting processes and oversee the prepara-tion and review of balance sheets, income statements and related financial reports, ensuring accuracy, transparency and compliance with internal, regulatory and external reporting stand-ards.

This role will play an important part in strengthening internal controls, managing reconcilia-tions, supporting audits and contributing to key local and Group initiatives. The Finance Man-ager will also provide day-to-day leadership to a team comprising four technical accountants and two financial accountants and will report directly to the Branch CFO.

You can look forward to

Duties & Responsibilities

Provide day-to-day leadership and oversight of the Finance team, including reviewing deliverables and supporting employees’ ongoing coaching, development and perfor-mance.
Oversee technical accounting processes, including the secondary or tertiary review and approval of accounts, as applicable.
Analyze financial movements and developments and assess their impact on the Ca-nadian Branch and its solvency position.
Manage all aspects of quarterly financial close including the preparation of statements, commentaries, and supporting documentation for Group Reporting as well as OSFI Reporting.
Support the establishment, execution and documentation of internal controls relating to financial reporting requirements, including maintaining and updating process docu-mentation.
Identify and help address risks relating to financial, regulatory and management reporting.
Helping to identify and address risks relating to financial and regulatory reporting.
Providing support to the local team in resolving reconciliation issues.
Liaise and coordinate with both external and internal audit.
Lead finance projects that focus on process improvement and efficiency across the end-to-end reporting cycle.
Ensure the appropriate tax accounting arrangements are maintained to allow tax liabili-ties to be calculated accurately in all material respects.
Collaborate with local and international stakeholders on Finance and Group initiatives.

We Offer You

The opportunity to work in a dynamic and global organization.
Competitive compensation and comprehensive company-paid benefits.
A half-day of paid time off to celebrate your birthday.
Eligibility to participate in Hannover Re’s annual incentive program.
Inclusive, collaborative, and high-performance culture.
A hybrid work model with flexible working hours.
Professional development and advancement opportunities.
Opportunities to contribute ideas, lead improvements and make a meaningful impact.

You come equipped with

Educational Background

Bachelors‘ degree in Finance, Business, Accounting or other related field

Experience & Qualifications

At least 7 years of progressive accounting experience in the property and casualty insurance or reinsurance industry.
An accounting designation (CPA or equivalent) would be preferred.
Strong and current technical knowledge of International Financial Reporting Stand-ards (IFRS17 in particular) and processes implementation and development.
Brings a strong sense of business insight and customer focus, paired with a hands‑on, results‑driven, “can‑do” attitude.
Ability to support business development efforts with accounting interpretations and analysis of reinsurance solutions provided to cedants.
Strong verbal and written communication skills including experience working with sen-ior management.
Exposure to SAP, MicroStrategy, Power BI, or similar reporting tools is an advantage.
Ability to work effectively in a multicultural environment.
Applicants must be legally entitled to work in Canada. Please note that we are unable to provide immigration sponsorship for this role.

We offer a competitive hiring range of $110,000 to $160,000, pay will align with skills, knowledge and experience of the candidate.

This posting is for a current active vacancy. We are actively recruiting to fill this position.

We are #somewhatdifferent—people with our own stories, experiences and career paths. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where individuals with diverse backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcomed and valued.

Hannover Re is committed to providing an accessible and inclusive recruitment process. Accommodations are available upon request for candidates participating in all stages of the recruitment and selection process. Candidates who require accommodation may indicate this when contacted regarding the recruitment process.

Apply using the “Apply now” button and become part of our diverse team.

More information about our work environment, career opportunities and development pro-grams can be found at www.hannover-re.com/en/career.
